features: Strong HD Sound: The two premium speakers, passive radiators, and gigantic batteries produce crisp surround sound that immerses you in the music. Additionally, this soundbar comes with Karaoke, party lights, and a mobile slot that transforms it into your very own audiovisual hub.

RGB Lights: Amp up the party with these flashy RGB lights. The vibrant lighting improves both the music and game dynamics experiences. The control button on the sound bar allows you to turn on and off the LED light. Suitable for your monitor's games, movies, and music.
It is more convenient to watch movies or videos and play games with a wireless Bluetooth Party Soundbar's stand function. Free up your hands and carry something simple and handy anyplace!
Freedom of Control: Blaze comes with a multiform connectivity assembly to give you more options to connect and play what you wish - Bluetooth/Aux/USB/SD Card/FM Support

Feel the Music: Blaze has a refined passive radiator setup installed that uses the pressure of sound created inside to further help the speaker to deliver deeper pitches creating heavier thumping bass.
This system is designed to be portable and lightweight so that you can take it anywhere. It is portable and substantial enough to spark a party.

Crossbeats Blaze B24 Bluetooth soundbar is the perfect way to upgrade your audio system and enjoy the home theatre experience. Up to 24W RMS, the stereo sound produced by B24 Gaming is impressively high-quality and provides deep bass and crisp vocals.
